name: What is the difference between a slab-on-grade and a crawl space foundation for an ADU?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a slab-on-grade and a crawl space foundation for an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: A slab-on-grade foundation involves pouring concrete directly onto a prepared ground surface, creating a solid, single-level base. This is generally quicker and less expensive. A crawl space foundation involves constructing a raised perimeter wall with a space beneath the floor, allowing access for plumbing and electrical work. While a crawl space might add to the initial cost and construction time, it provides easier access for future repairs or modifications, which can be a practical tradeoff to consider.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slab-on-grade is a concrete base directly on the ground, while a crawl space creates an accessible void beneath the floor.
